Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final req = await createRerankRequestFromJson(json: '{"documents":["Python is a programming language.","Cats are cute animals.","Python was created by Guido van Rossum.","The sun is a star."],"model":"rerank-v3.5","query":"What is Python?","top_n":2}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.rerank(req: req);
    stdout.writeln(result.results);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].relevanceScore);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
